headline: Deep value or falling knife?
chart_note: 52-week range: $37.95 - $76.97. Currently $38.41, sitting right at the bottom of its 52-week range.
why_today: Fiscal Q1 revenue grew about 2% YoY to $12.94B, but Greater China sales fell 12% reported (17% currency-neutral) as Nike overhauls its Chinese distributor network - the core reason the stock trades near a 52-week low.
pro_1: Analyst average price target of $50.66 implies roughly 30% upside from current levels
pro_2: Dividend yield has climbed to 4.3% after the selloff - a rare level for Nike historically
con_1: Consensus rating is only Hold (11 buy / 25 hold / 3 sell of 39 analysts) - Wall Street is not convinced yet
con_2: China, historically a top-3 market, is still shrinking double digits with more restructuring ahead into 2027
